/* selectMasterWmStStockMovemntReleaseList */ SELECT A.MOVE_NO, /* 재고이동요청번호 */ A.MOVE_SEQ, /* 재고이동요청순번 */ A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR, /* 출발물류센터 */ (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR) AS WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR_TEXT, /* 출발물류센터 */ A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_TO, /* 도착물류센터 */ (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_TO) AS WAREHOUSE_CODE_TO_TEXT, /* 출발물류센터 */ A.STDCATLG_ID, /* 품목코드 */ B.DESCRIPTION, /* 품목명 */ B.SPECIFICATION, /* 규격 */ A.REQ_QTY, /* 이동요청수량 */ C.AVAIL_QTY, /* 재고수량 */ NVL(SUM(A.INV_QTY),0) AS INV_QTY_PRE, /* 기출고수량 */ (NVL(A.REQ_QTY,0)) - (NVL(SUM(A.INV_QTY),0)) AS INV_QTY, /* 출고수량(잔량) */ A.REQ_DATE, /* 이동요청일자 */ A.REQ_TIME, /* 이동요청시간 */ (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.REQ_USER_ID) AS REQ_USER_NM, /* 이동요청자 */ A.REQ_USER_ID, /* 이동요청자 */ TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS INV_DATE, /* 이동출고일자 */ B.CONTRACT_NO, B.CONTRACT_SEQ, A.MOVE_REMARK /* 비고 */ FROM BNTWMSMOVE A, ICOMCQDT B, WMSSTCK C WHERE A.STATUS = '1' /* 이동요청(출고대기)인 것 조회 */ AND A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR = C.WAREHOUSE_CODE AND A.STDCATLG_ID = C.STDCATLG_ID AND B.BUYER = C.ORG_WAREHOUSE_CODE AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.STDCATLG_ID AND B.CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO AND B.CONTRACT_SEQ = C.CONTRACT_SEQ AND C.AGENT = 'KRKORE0001' AND (A.CLOSE_DATE IS NULL OR A.CLOSE_DATE = '') /* 삭제(마감)되지 않은 데이터 */
AND A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR = #{st_warehouse_code_fr} /* 조회조건(출발물류센터) */
AND A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_TO = #{st_warehouse_code_to} /* 조회조건(도착물류센터) */
AND A.MOVE_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_move_no} || '%' /* 조회조건(출고번호) */
AND A.STDCATLG_ID LIKE '%' || #{st_stdcatlg_id} || '%' /* 조회조건(품목코드) */
AND B.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_description} || '%' /* 조회조건(품목명) */
AND A.REQ_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} /* 조회조건(요청일자) */
GROUP BY A.MOVE_NO, A.MOVE_SEQ, A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR, A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_TO, A.STDCATLG_ID, B.DESCRIPTION, B.SPECIFICATION, A.REQ_QTY, C.AVAIL_QTY, A.REQ_DATE, A.REQ_TIME, A.REQ_USER_ID, B.CONTRACT_NO, B.CONTRACT_SEQ, A.MOVE_REMARK
SELECT TEXT1 AS WAREHOUSE_CODE FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'WR01' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND COMPANY_CODE = #{st_com_code} AND CODE = #{st_user_id}

SELECT NVL(B.AVAIL_QTY, '0') AS AVAIL_QTY FROM BNTWMSMOVE A, WMSSTCK B WHERE A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR = B.WAREHOUSE_CODE AND A.STDCATLG_ID = B.STDCATLG_ID AND B.AGENT = 'KRKORE0001' AND A.MOVE_NO = #{MOVE_NO} /* 재고이동요청번호 */ AND A.MOVE_SEQ = #{MOVE_SEQ} /* 재고이동요청순번 */ AND A.WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR = #{WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR} /* 출발물류센터 */ AND A.STDCATLG_ID = #{STDCATLG_ID} /* 품목코드 */
mapper.update: UPDATE WMSSTCK SET TOT_QTY = NVL(TOT_QTY,0) - TO_NUMBER(#{INV_QTY}), AVAIL_QTY = NVL(AVAIL_QTY,0) - TO_NUMBER(#{INV_QTY}), CHANGE_USER = #{st_user_id}, CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{WAREHOUSE_CODE_FR} AND STDCATLG_ID = #{STDCATLG_ID} AND AGENT = 'KRKORE0001'

UPDATE BNTWMSMOVE SET INV_QTY = #{INV_QTY}, INV_USER_ID = #{st_user_id}, INV_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), INV_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), DELIVERY_QTY = #{INV_QTY}, DELIVERY_USER_ID = #{st_user_id}, DELIVERY_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), DELIVERY_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), STATUS = '2' WHERE MOVE_NO = #{MOVE_NO} AND MOVE_SEQ = #{MOVE_SEQ}

UPDATE BNTWMSMOVE SET STATUS = '9', CLOSE_USER_ID = #{st_user_id}, CLOSE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), CLOSE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE MOVE_NO = #{MOVE_NO} AND MOVE_SEQ = #{MOVE_SEQ}
